free_tier.stated: 1 TB of free storage per user, announced 2026-06-26, 'made possible through a National Science Foundation Campus Cyberinfrastructure grant' and backed by the Open Storage Network. Additional storage $200/TB one-time. 550 files max per record.

egress.terms: Unmetered egress. Downloads stream directly from data.caltech.edu. Storage resides on the Open Storage Network, an NSF-funded academic infrastructure fabric.

record.tooling: InvenioRDM REST API (/api/records, files under /api/records/<id>/files/<key>/content); purpose-built client caltechlibrary/caltechdata_api (github.com/caltechlibrary/caltechdata_api, 13 stars); the whole instance's source is public at caltechlibrary/caltechdata (11 stars) so the quota config is auditable
record.chaining: Default allocation is 1 TB free per registered institutional user. Deposited records are not individually account-capped, providing higher baseline capacity than general repositories.
record.limits_note: 550 files per record; deposit requires a Caltech (access.caltech) identity, which is the real gate. The API reads are fully anonymous but writes are not open to the public.
record.reliability_note: Anonymous API reads work and are generous (X-RateLimit-Limit: 500 observed on /api/records). The 1 TB allocation is explicitly funded by a time-bounded NSF grant, so the number has a funding horizon attached.

evidence.proved: read live (Last Updated Jun 29, 2026): 'All users with an access.caltech account get 1 TB of free storage through CaltechDATA. Additional storage requires a one-time charge of $200 / TB ... Individual records can include a maximum of 550 files.'

record.provider: InvenioRDM platform class — CaltechDATA, TU Graz, TU Wien, TalTech, KTH, Bamberg, MSD-Live

free_tier.stated: Per-record, NOT per-account: RDM_FILES_DEFAULT_QUOTA_SIZE = 10 GB and RDM_FILES_DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 GB, with APP_RDM_DEPOSIT_FORM_QUOTA maxFiles = 100. Records are unlimited. This is the structural inverse of Dataverse: InvenioRDM ships a real quota and it is per-object, so total space is unbounded while each record is capped at 10 GB.

record.chaining: Excellent for the archive workload if registration were open, because 10 GB x unlimited records is unbounded in aggregate. It is not open on any instance tested.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 10 GB/record and 10 GB/file, 100 files/record. No per-account cap exists in the platform, so no instance can report one.
record.reliability_note: All seven instances 404 on /signup/, which in InvenioRDM means SECURITY_REGISTERABLE is off; only Zenodo (already counted elsewhere) and the CERN demo return anything other than 404.
